purpose: Audit availability of independent time-confirmed newly ice-free breeding patches joined to verified surveyed non-detection/detection histories. No count outcomes, climate association or colonization effect estimation.

avoid_reopening: Paper 2 V3 2km area×heterogeneity inference already nonconfirmatory (paper p=0.0947)
MAPPPD V41 strict physical land-continuity test sample STOP
AADC consecutive-season East Antarctica A→P n=1 source STOP

candidate_sources.name: SCAR ADD high-res land polygon v7.13
candidate_sources.use: static geography QA only; composite 1990s–2026; not a calendar-year exposure map

candidate_sources.name: Zavodovski penguin colony polygon time series 2010–2025
candidate_sources.use: one-island multi-time colony footprint pilot; layer-level image-year and cloud gap-filling required; not new ice-free land

candidate_sources.name: Loebel et al 2025 AP glacier calving fronts
candidate_sources.use: time-specific glacier front source; independent ice-free-patch construction and proximity/coverage validation required

candidate_sources.name: Cimino et al 2026 Point 8 colonization
candidate_sources.use: prior-art single site 2018–2023 demonstration; not new discovery

candidate_sources.name: AADC East Antarctica P/A search events
candidate_sources.use: prior consecutive-year P/A risk-set pilot insufficient (1 A→P); must not impute NR

csv_contract.exposure_meaning: first_year-last_year brackets credible new exposure of a physical patch independently of penguin observations. Both verified prior-ice and verified current ice-free state required, and an exact same patch-to-site spatial match.
csv_contract.survey_meaning: state A denotes verified visited and protocol-supported absence, P denotes verified presence, NR/missing/unsurveyed is not absence; count magnitudes must not be included.
csv_contract.consecutive_rule: Only same-site same-species adjacent surveyed seasons after the LATEST exposure-confirmation year count as observed A/P transitions. Nonconsecutive gaps are interval-censored and do not count as annual A→P.
csv_contract.landmass_rule: landmass_id is a verified physical continuous landmass, not a SCAR polygon feature ID or administrative MasterSite; aliases resolved without inspecting outcomes.
csv_contract.temporal_alignment_rule: No adjacency by calendar year from a 1990s–2026 composite coastline edition; original image date required.
csv_contract.source_novelty_rule: Raw satellite imagery and compiled polygon layer can share upstream sources; use original footprint and citation to avoid false independent replication.

synthetic_validation.test_execution: local Python unittest and py_compile passed; no original site exposure-sighting combined dataset run

descriptive_sample_support_gates.meaning: Eligibility threshold for considering an inferential design, not a power calculation, evidence of biological effect, or a license to fit models without separate predeclared hypothesis.

interpretation_limitations: PASS would only prove source availability, not causal identification, independent surveys, calibrated detection or transferable settlement dynamics.
Exposures identified after viewing colony occupancy may induce ascertainment bias and require independent whole risk-set candidate generation.
Only exact source-verified spatial matches are eligible; unsupported unknown year, patch, visit, or species are not treated as ecological zero.
next_data_gate: Find independent mapped before/after ice exposure and surveyed post-exposure A/P histories on >=5 physical landmasses; hold biological testing until linked original source supports pass.
